title: One-Reference Material Retrieval: Code and Numerical Results
description: Code, fixed split manifests, per-query predictions, stored numerical results and ranking/score arrays for the current leather, T1K+ Fabric, MatSim and DTD evaluations. Historical v1.0.1 is preserved separately. This archive does not contain original photographs, pretrained weights, training checkpoints or the complete feature/pixel caches. See current/README.md for verification and reconstruction limits. Frozen retrieval, score fusion and ResNet50 adaptation are separate configurations. Source code is MIT; derived numerical outputs are CC BY 4.0; original third-party terms remain applicable. The compact GitHub tree omits binary arrays; the complete version 2.0.0 archive is at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23794034.
